adapters.mechanism: One canonical hourly RRULE whose BYMINUTE is rotated 00/15/30/45 by each invocation.
adapters.documented_platform_floor: Ordinary eligible paid recurring tasks officially support up to once per hour; quarter-shift mutation is an RRuleR experiment rather than a documented 15-minute recurrence primitive.
adapters.observed_limitation: Cannot create a rescue wake inside the current quarter when the reasoning invocation ends early.

adapters.mechanism: ChatGPT Work event-triggered task responding to supported GitHub pull-request activity; candidate uses PR commit updates as a controlled continuation chain.
adapters.documented_ceiling: Up to 30 event-triggered executions per hour and 720 per day across event-triggered tasks on eligible plans.
adapters.supported_activity_evidence: Official GitHub connector docs list PR opened/ready/closed and, depending on trigger, reviews, comments, commit updates, or completed merges.
adapters.critical_constraint: Official standard ChatGPT GitHub app documentation says repository access is read-only for analysis/search. RRuleR's current chat connector can write, but an event-triggered Work worker must not be assumed to inherit that write capability. The chain is viable only if the triggered worker has an approved write-capable GitHub action/plugin or another safe producer for the next PR event.

lab.purpose: Dedicated public-safe commit-update event lane; do not merge while used for wake experiments.

adapters.potential_value: If a triggered worker can durably checkpoint and emit exactly one next-generation event, a 10-14 minute objective can continue across disposable micro-generations with far smaller dead gaps.
proof_required: provision Work trigger for PR commit update if exposed
prove triggered worker can perform required RRuleR durable writes without manual approval each generation

adapters.potential_value: May reduce dependence on frequent wakes if a worker can continue after the user leaves.
proof_required: scheduled/event-triggered invocation can enter or delegate to compatible background execution
runtime lifetime materially exceeds current invocation span

next_feasibility_experiment: First prove event-triggered Work write capability for RRuleR in a bounded test. Only then provision/attempt the three-generation PR commit-update chain on draft PR #1. Keep quarter scheduler active as fallback.
